value.rationale: This is a complete classification of natural geometric fixed spaces and their integral residual permutation modules for all nontrivial translation subgroups of unbounded Cartesian products of complete graphs, with arbitrary composite and unequal factors. It exhibits sharply distinct empty, contractible-component, and regular isolated-orbit regimes, a two-coordinate involution boundary, and disconnected fixed spaces despite a connected ambient Čech nerve. Ambient Betti numbers and rational characters do not determine the asserted topology.
